rules.rule: Hire date cannot be more than 180 days in the future (DB level, TRG_EMP_BEFORE_INSERT, ORA-20501).
Forms-side hire-date-in-future check uses a 90-day threshold, tighter than the DB's 180-day rule — the two enforcement points disagree.
rules.source: HRMS_EMPLOYEE.xml WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM (per prior deep-scan; not re-read this pass)

rules.rule: Email must be unique among ACTIVE_FLAG='Y' employees only — a terminated employee's email may be reused by a new hire.
A terminated employee cannot be directly reactivated (EMPLOYMENT_STATUS TERMINATED→ACTIVE is blocked); must go through a separate 'rehire' process instead.
rules.source: TRG_EMP_BEFORE_UPDATE, ORA-20503; corroborated by PKG_EMPLOYEE.rehire_employee existing as a distinct procedure from update_employee

rules.rule: EMPLOYEES rows can never be physically deleted — any DELETE raises ORA-20504; the documented workaround is ACTIVE_FLAG='N' plus Forms CLEAR_RECORD (not DELETE_RECORD).

Salary range per job grade is enforced structurally (MAX_SALARY >= MIN_SALARY) but NOT that an employee's actual salary falls within their job's grade band — PKG_VALIDATION.validate_salary_for_grade exists as a callable check but is not a DB constraint, so it can be bypassed by any path that doesn't call it explicitly.
Leave requires a minimum tenure before it can be taken, per leave type (e.g., FMLA requires 365 days tenure, COMP requires 90 days, PTO/SICK/JURY/BEREAVE require 0).

Leave accrual and carryover rules vary by leave type: PTO accrues 1.25 days/month up to a 20-day max balance with a 5-day carryover expiring after 3 (months, presumed); SICK accrues 0.833 days/month, no expiry on its 10-day carryover; COMP/FMLA/JURY/BEREAVE do not accrue at all (fixed grant model implied).

LEAVE_BALANCES.AVAILABLE formula (canonical): OPENING_BALANCE + ACCRUED - USED + ADJUSTMENT - PENDING. VW_LEAVE_SUMMARY silently uses a different formula omitting PENDING — a business-rule fork, not just a display quirk, since it changes what 'available leave' means depending on which surface an employee/manager looks at.

GOAL_CATEGORY has 5 valid database values (BUSINESS, DEVELOPMENT, LEADERSHIP, INNOVATION, COMPLIANCE) but the Forms UI poplist only allows selecting 3 of them (Business, Development, Leadership) — INNOVATION/COMPLIANCE goals can exist (e.g. from a data load) and display, but cannot be newly assigned through the standard UI.
rules.source: PERFORMANCE_GOALS.CHK_GOAL_CATEGORY vs HRMS_PERFORMANCE.xml poplist (per prior deep-scan)

rules.rule: 'Latest payroll run' is defined as the single highest RUN_ID among APPROVED runs, globally — not per pay-frequency or per employee population, despite the schema supporting REGULAR/SUPPLEMENTAL/BONUS/FINAL run types that could legitimately run in parallel.

Audit retention default is 365 days (PKG_AUDIT.purge_old_records default parameter) — this is a business/compliance rule expressed only as a procedure default, not an enforced scheduled policy (no DBMS_SCHEDULER job found).

Only SALARY_RECORDS, LEAVE_REQUESTS (status changes), and DEPARTMENTS are audited at the DB-trigger level; EMPLOYEES itself (beyond the EMPLOYEE_HISTORY side-channel, which is broken) has no AFTER trigger calling PKG_AUDIT — meaning core employee PII/profile changes are NOT captured in AUDIT_LOG at all, only in the broken EMPLOYEE_HISTORY path.
rules.source: plsql/triggers/trg_audit.sql (only 3 triggers) vs plsql/triggers/trg_employees.sql (BEFORE triggers only, no AFTER/audit call)

rules.rule: Session timeout is hard-coded at 30 minutes as a private constant (c_session_timeout_min CONSTANT NUMBER := 30) in PKG_SECURITY.pkb. SYSTEM_PARAMETERS.SESSION_TIMEOUT_MIN is decorative — changing it has no effect on actual session expiry. Timeout is measured from LOGIN_TIME (set once at login), NOT from last activity — this is a hard absolute 30-minute session limit, not an inactivity timeout. A user actively working is cut off after exactly 30 minutes.

Password minimum length is a configurable business rule (SYSTEM_PARAMETERS.PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH = 8) but there is no account-lockout-after-failed-attempts rule implemented, per PKG_SECURITY's documented known issues — brute-force protection is a documented gap, not an oversight in this analysis.
Fiscal year starts in month 10 (October) per SYSTEM_PARAMETERS.FISCAL_YEAR_START — relevant to any payroll/reporting logic keyed off fiscal vs. calendar year.

GL (General Ledger) and Benefits external feeds are toggleable via SYSTEM_PARAMETERS (GL_FEED_STATUS, BENEFITS_FEED_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'). NOTE: generate_gl_journal reads this via PKG_COMMON.get_param — kill-switch IS consulted. export_benefits_feed does NOT check BENEFITS_FEED_STATUS — that kill-switch is ignored by the benefits export code.

Federal tax brackets are hard-coded as 2024 values in PKG_PAYROLL.calculate_federal_tax. TAX_BRACKETS table exists but is never read. Single/Married-Separate: 10%/$11,600, 12%/$47,150, 22%/$100,525, 24%/$191,950, 32%/$243,725, 35%/$609,350, 37%+ . Married-Joint: 10%/$23,200, 12%/$94,300, 22%/$201,050, 24%/$383,900, 32%/$487,450, 35%/$731,200, 37%+. Standard deductions: Single=$14,600, Married=$29,200. Allowance reduction: $4,300 each.

FICA: 6.2% employee share up to $168,600 annual wage base (2024). Returns $0 once wage base is met for the year (YTD tracking in calculate_fica). Medicare: 1.45% base + additional 0.9% on earnings above $200,000 YTD.
State income tax is a flat rate per state (simplified model): CA=7.25%, NY=6.85%, TX=0%, FL=0%, WA=0%, IL=4.95%, PA=3.07%, OH=4.00%, NJ=6.37%, MA=5.00%, all others=5.00% default.

Pretax deductions (401k, HSA, medical premiums) are NOT subtracted before applying federal or state tax brackets. Code comment: 'Simplified; should subtract pretax deductions'. This means taxes are overcalculated for employees with pretax benefit elections.

HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD filing status is valid in EMPLOYEE_TAX_INFO.FILING_STATUS (check constraint allows it) but produces $0 federal tax withholding — the CASE block in calculate_federal_tax only handles SINGLE, MARRIED_SEPARATE, and MARRIED_JOINT.
Backdated leave requests are allowed up to 5 calendar days in the past (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - p_start_date <= 5). Requests older than 5 days are rejected with ORA-20211.

Leave accrual batch only processes LEAVE_TYPES with ACCRUAL_FREQUENCY = 'MONTHLY'. Any leave type defined with a different frequency (e.g. BIWEEKLY) will never accrue automatically — it is permanently excluded by the WHERE clause.

Carryover expiry is calculated as ADD_MONTHS(January 1 of next year, LEAVE_TYPES.CARRYOVER_EXPIRY). Example: PTO CARRYOVER_EXPIRY=3 → carryover expires April 1 of the following year. SICK has NULL CARRYOVER_EXPIRY (no expiry).

Termination auto-cancels PENDING leave requests via direct UPDATE (bypasses PKG_LEAVE.cancel_leave_request). APPROVED future leave is NOT cancelled. LEAVE_BALANCES.PENDING is NOT adjusted — the column overstates pending balance after termination.

Rehire overwrites the employee's HIRE_DATE with the rehire date. Original hire date is lost from EMPLOYEES. TERMINATION_DATE and TERMINATION_REASON are also cleared. Any tenure/seniority-based calculation (VW_ACTIVE_EMPLOYEES.TENURE_YEARS, MIN_TENURE_DAYS leave eligibility) uses only the rehire date after this operation.
Employee names are stored as UPPER(TRIM()) in EMPLOYEES.FIRST_NAME and LAST_NAME. All display formatting (INITCAP) is applied by PKG_COMMON.format_name at display time, not stored.
Manager circular chain detection in validate_manager silently exits at 15 levels without raising an error. Org trees deeper than 15 levels can have circular references inserted without detection.

Notification email is dispatched via UTL_SMTP to hard-coded SMTP server 'smtp.internal.company.com' port 25 with sender 'hrms-noreply@company.com'. These constants in PKG_NOTIFICATION.pkb body are NOT read from SYSTEM_PARAMETERS at runtime — updating SYSTEM_PARAMETERS has no effect on actual email delivery.

Notification queue is processed in batches of 50 (default p_batch_size) ordered by PRIORITY ASC then CREATED_DATE ASC. Failed notifications are retried up to 3 times (default p_max_retries in retry_failed). Scheduler: every 5 minutes via DBMS_SCHEDULER.

GL feed output is pipe-delimited format (H=header, D=detail, T=trailer) written to Oracle Directory 'GL_FEED_OUT' as GL_JOURNAL_{run_id}_{YYYYMMDD}.dat, consumed by Oracle Financials batch import. Benefits feed output is fixed-width ADP format (EmpNum=10, FName=30, LName=30, DOB=10, HireDate=10, Status=12, MaritalStatus=10, Gender=1, DepFName=30, DepLName=30, Relationship=20, DepDOB=10) written to 'BENEFITS_FEED_OUT' as BENEFITS_{YYYYMMDD}.txt.

Time and attendance import (PKG_INTEGRATION.import_time_attendance) is a TODO stub — the procedure reads the input file from 'TIME_ATTENDANCE_IN' but contains no CSV parsing logic and makes no database writes. LDAP/AD org sync (sync_org_structure) is also a stub.

change_password validates password complexity (min 8 chars, at least one uppercase A-Z, at least one digit 0-9) but NEVER writes to USER_CREDENTIALS — the entire procedure body is a stub that validates but does not persist. Lowercase and special character requirements are NOT enforced. Error codes: ORA-20310 (length), ORA-20311 (uppercase), ORA-20312 (digit).

PKG_SECURITY.authenticate resolves email collisions silently: if multiple ACTIVE employees share the same email, the user with the lowest EMP_ID is authenticated without any error or warning. This is the TOO_MANY_ROWS handler: SELECT MIN(EMP_ID).

VW_EMPLOYEE_COMPENSATION joins SALARY_RECORDS with only ACTIVE_FLAG='Y' and no date-scope predicate (no EFFECTIVE_DATE <= SYSDATE, no END_DATE guard). VW_ACTIVE_EMPLOYEES uses the correct date-scoped join. If any employee has two ACTIVE_FLAG='Y' salary records concurrently (e.g. during a salary create before end-dating the prior), VW_EMPLOYEE_COMPENSATION returns duplicate rows with incorrect COMPA_RATIO values.
